newsitem.title: UK: British Land gains on property sale.
newsitem.headline: British Land gains on property sale.

text.p: Shares in British Land Co Plc put on 17p to 624-1/2p, after news it sold a portfolio of office and retail properties for 140 million stg, a good price, analysts said.

"It looks like they've made about 40 percent capital return since about 1991/92 plus income. It's a good price and the market's very squeezy at the moment, so any positive news is lifting share prices more than normal," said one analyst.
British Land said the cost of the portfolio was 101 million stg and its income had more than covered interest and other holding costs throughout the period of ownership.
Earlier this year, British Land raised 300 million stg in the Eurobond markets. Today's news bred vague speculation that the company may be building a war chest for future acquisitions.
The analyst scotched the talk. "This is all part of their normal portfolio trading," he said.
